nodes.description: Unable to help yourself you claim all of the unknown power.
nodes.technicalDescription:
200% stronger Assembly Lines, AI Managers, Servers, Data Centers, and Planets. 10% less Cash and Science.

Buff stacks Multiplicatively. Debuff stacks Additively for a total of 50% less.

nodes.description: Go faster, innovate harder, and take some prisoners.
nodes.technicalDescription: Servers, AI Managers, and Assembly Lines are 3x stronger. Planets and Data Centers are 3x weaker.

nodes.description: This breakthrough technology halves the resources required for your AI Managers to run, giving them twice the yield.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies AI Managers Assembly Line production by 2.

nodes.description: Androids actively repair panels while in orbit, greatly improving panel lifetime.
nodes.technicalDescription:
While purchased Androids scales from 0 to 200 seconds of Panel Lifetime over a 10 minute span.
This resets on Infinity/Quantum Leap.

nodes.description: Utilizing wasted resources you boost your panels lifetime using your AI Managers to process better designs.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase Panel Lifetime by 5 * log10(AI Managers).

nodes.description: Overclocking capabilities allow your Assembly Lines to produce twice as many Bots.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies Assembly Lines Bot production by 2.

nodes.description: More Planets allow for larger Assembly Lines. Mega-Assembly Lines that is. Probably a good idea to let the bots handle this.
nodes.technicalDescription: The Cost of Assembly Lines is divided by the current amount of Planets.

nodes.description: Avocados are cool, and so are you. If you found this well done.
nodes.technicalDescription: Building production is multiplied by 2 at 69 purchases.

nodes.description: After much thought, you decide the multiverse is real and focus on sending some of your knowledge to the next universe.
nodes.technicalDescription: Set one Skill Point aside for your next infinity.

nodes.description: You experiment with lower orbits. The heat of the sun degrades your panels faster but the energy output is greatly improved!
nodes.technicalDescription: Shorten Panel Lifetime by 5s, and triple panel production.

nodes.description: All spacefaring civilizations eventually come to realize that cooperation is the only way forward. Thus, the best of the best represent each species in the citadel council, responsible for guiding the universe towards a safe future.
nodes.technicalDescription: Panel Lifetime is multiplied by log1.2(Panels Decayed).

nodes.description: Create dedicated server 'clusters' for your own benefit.
nodes.technicalDescription: For every log10(Servers), Servers are 5% better, and Server Production from Rudimentary Singularity is 5% stronger.

nodes.description: Theoretical made fact. Your army of scientists manage to solve cold fusion. What more lays in front of you? The future is a bright one.
nodes.technicalDescription: Reduces Cash income by 50%, increases Science by 10x

nodes.description: Advanced Data Center infrastructure allows for more complex Server designs
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies Data Center Server production by 2.

nodes.description: Meow. Linking up your fancy dimensional Data Centers with your regular old boring Data Centers makes them far more capable. The resources needed do make your Planets slightly worse, however.
nodes.technicalDescription: 5x as many Data Centers from Pocket Dimensions. 25% less Data Center production from Planets.

nodes.description: Breakthroughs in CPU manufacturing allow your science bots to calculate twice as much data.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies Science production by 2.

nodes.description: Unlock the full potential of your space empire with Dyson Subsidies. Get a big boost in Cash flow before you surround a star and enjoy increased Bot production after. Take your game to the next level and conquer the galaxy with Dyson Subsidies.
nodes.technicalDescription: Before you surround a star you gain 3x Cash, after a star is surrounded this becomes 2x Bot production.

nodes.description: Shift your goals to economic growth with singular focus.
nodes.technicalDescription: 20x Cash, 0.25x Science

nodes.description: Self improving bots create a surge in economic progress.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies Cash by 5 while you have at least 50% of bots assigned to Panel Production.

nodes.description: Imagine a future where Assembly Lines stretch far into the horizon, bustling with the hum of robots tirelessly working. While this may sound like a productivity paradise, it also comes with a hefty price tag. Longer Assembly Lines mean an increased number of Bots, but as a result, they gobble up valuable real estate, chipping away at the already dwindling power of our planets.
nodes.technicalDescription: 5x Bot production. Planets are 50% weaker.

nodes.description: As you begin to piece the fragments together, you manage to decipher ways to improve all of your buildings.
nodes.technicalDescription: If you have at least 4 other Fragment Skills purchased, Triple the production of all Buildings.

nodes.description: Fission just won't cut it, Fusion is the way forward. Fusion lets you create miniature suns.
nodes.technicalDescription: Boost Panel Production by 5x, reduce Cash income by 25%

nodes.description: The Galactic Paradigm Shift is a significant increase in Planet production within a galaxy. The effects of this change impact intergalactic civilizations and the galaxy as a whole, presenting both opportunities and challenges. The cause of the shift is still unknown.
nodes.technicalDescription: Planets produce 1.5x as much before you Engulf a Galaxy. They produce 3x as much afterwards.

nodes.description: Surrounding black holes is unheard of, but you manage it after years of research!
nodes.technicalDescription: Boosts Cash gain by 10% for every Galaxy engulfed.

nodes.description: A space telescope that was launched into low Earth orbit in 1990 and remains in operation to this day.
nodes.technicalDescription: Double the effect of Scientific Planets.

nodes.description: Fancy name for a fancy boost. You always excelled in geometry, time to apply the knowledge to your dyson swarm empire.
nodes.technicalDescription: Data Centers gain a 10% production for every log10(Servers).

nodes.description:
Counting sheep is such a breeze, Helps me fall asleep with ease, One by one they jump the fence, Takes me to dreamland in suspense.
White and fluffy, soft and neat, Lead me to slumber so sweet, Close my eyes, take a deep breath, Counting sheep, I meet my rest.
Over the hills and far away, Sheep are counting every day, A bedtime ritual, tried and true, Helping me and maybe you.
nodes.technicalDescription: Doubles the effect running offline time has.

nodes.description: Collect matter, build buildings and fly your shuttle between the stars.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase Science production by 1% for every 100 million active Panels additively.

nodes.description: Where is all this power coming from? You decide to take it anyway.
nodes.technicalDescription:
100% stronger Assembly Lines, AI Managers, Servers, Data Centers, and Planets. 15% less Cash and Science.

Buff stacks Multiplicatively. Debuff stacks Additively for a total of 40% less.

nodes.description: Having successfully recieved data from another universe you decide to pay it forward.
nodes.technicalDescription: Set one Skill Point aside for your next infinity.

nodes.description: Equipped with high-resolution and high-sensitivity instruments, allowing it to view objects too old, distant, or faint for the Hubble Space Telescope. Launched on 25 December 2021.
nodes.technicalDescription: Quadruple the effect of Scientific Planets.

nodes.description: You like to get your hands dirty, so you set to work setting up Assembly Lines yourself.
nodes.technicalDescription: Bring back the Manual bot building button and make it produce Assembly Lines. 2% of total Assembly Lines per completion capping at 20x your AI Manager production] Also reduces the manual creation time to 0.2s

nodes.description: Lets push that a little further, it seemed to work well.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase the production multiplier from 2% to 3%

nodes.description: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to improve your Cash gain, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase cash gain by 1.75x Increase this bonus by 0.75x for every other purchased Fragment Skill.

nodes.description: Harness the ancient power of the One Minute Plan for boosted production. This timeless strategy offers increased efficiency and solidifies your place as a master of the universe.
nodes.technicalDescription: If Panel Lifetime is below a minute, 1.5x Assembly Line production. Otherwise, 5x Assembly Line Production

nodes.description: One of your ships discovers a new material orbiting a black hole, you manage to find a way to drastically increase panel lifetime.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increases the duration of Panels by 20 seconds.

nodes.description: Panel Maintenance increases the lifespan of panels by dedicating robotic resources to its upkeep. The more maintenance efforts, the longer the panels will last and function effectively. This process extends the life of panels and ensures optimal performance, reducing the risk of failures and improving system reliability.
nodes.technicalDescription: Add 1 second of Panel Lifetime for every % of Workers.

nodes.description: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to improve your Solar Panels, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?
nodes.technicalDescription: +5s of Panel Lifetime. Double this bonus for every other purchased Fragment Skill. (10s for 1, 40s for 3)

nodes.description: What is more soothing than the blue color of the sky? But of course solar panels emitting blue light. All your population now works with far less stress, increasing the scientific production.
nodes.technicalDescription: Boost Science production by 5000%.

nodes.description: Why spend multiple threads computing multiple things, when you can instead use all threads to compute all things, in a parallel fashion. Your Servers become much more efficient this way, boosting your Data Centers.
nodes.technicalDescription: Data Centers gain a 10% production for every log2(Servers).

nodes.description: One fine day in the middle of the night, 2 dead men got up to fight, back to back they faced each other, drew their swords and shot each other. Oh wait this is about processing.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase Server effectiveness by 5% for every log2(Servers).

nodes.description: So, planets are made out of matter, right? Well, so are Assembly Lines! Getting enough assembly lines together should create more planets. Don't ask why robots don't do the same.
nodes.technicalDescription: Gain Planets equal to log10(Assembly Lines).

nodes.description: Through more efficient use of space and construction equipment, Data Center build time is halved.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies Planet Data Center production by 2.

nodes.description: It was only a matter of time before your most trusted workers entered your pocket dimensions. The results are quite astonishing, be it they take time to be noticeable.
nodes.technicalDescription: Over the course of an hour, Pocket Dimensions gain a production boost with the cap of 100x.

nodes.description: Discovery of pocket dimensions allow multiple Data Centers to be placed in layers. Ya know, like Onions. Or is it more like a TARDIS?
nodes.technicalDescription:
Produces Data Centers based on Log10(Worker Bots)

Starting at 10 Worker Bots, you gain 1 Data Center per second, this increases by 1 each time you multiply your Workers by 10.

nodes.description: Breakthroughs in Pocket technology allow ludicrous improvements.
nodes.technicalDescription: Pocket Protectors instead multiplies your Data Center production by log10(Scientists).

nodes.description: Your scientists want in on this as well.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase Data Center production by log10(Scientists).

nodes.description: Use Cash to boost Cash, is economic manipulation still frowned upon?
nodes.technicalDescription: Cash production ^1.03.

nodes.description: Use Science to boost Science, how? We will never know.
nodes.technicalDescription: Science production ^1.05.

nodes.description: Improved networking protocols increase your Scientists ability to work closely together, improving science yield greatly.
nodes.technicalDescription: For every 1% of bots invested in science gain, +100% science production. Multiplicative with other upgrades, but not with itself.

nodes.description: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to improve your entire production line, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?
nodes.technicalDescription: Reduce the starting point of the 1% bonus per bought building to 90. Reduce it by another 5 for every other purchased Fragment Skill.

nodes.description: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to improve your Assembly Lines, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?
nodes.technicalDescription: Assembly Lines produce 1.5x as much. Increase this bonus by 0.5x for every other purchased Fragment Skill.

nodes.description: You become one with your Bots, perfection on this scale never before seen.
nodes.technicalDescription: Gain 25% more Bots for each unspent Skill Point.

nodes.description: WIth singular focus you clear your mind of all thoughts that don't include Cash or Science.
nodes.technicalDescription: Gain 50% more Cash/Science for each unspent Skill Point.

nodes.description: You transcend beyond reality, consuming everything in your path you become one with the Universe.
nodes.technicalDescription: Gain a 42% bonus to Everything for each unspent Skill Point.

nodes.description: Using the same old server line-up seriously dampers with your progress. By utilizing quantum mechanics, you can now have servers that are simultaneously on, off, and both, boosting their efficiency in ways you don't quite understand.
nodes.technicalDescription: Production of Data Centers from Pocket Dimensions is boosted by Log2(Rudimentry Singularity Production).

nodes.description: Turn the filthy xeno scum into useful "voluntary" colonization and enslaving units.
nodes.technicalDescription: Panel production multiplied by log2(Panels Decayed) / 10.

nodes.description: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to improve your Bots, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?
nodes.technicalDescription: Science and Cash Boost base is increased by 20%. Increase the base of this by 10% for every other purchased Fragment Skill.

nodes.description: Fear is but a tool for the strong to make the weak be more productive. Red solar panels spread fear across your galaxies, forcing your population to pay more subsidies to you.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiply Cash production by 5000%.

nodes.description: Renewables surge in popularity leading you to focus on panel lifetime improvements.
nodes.technicalDescription:
Starting at 10 million worker bots, panel lifetime increases by 10%. This increases by 10% each time you multiply your workers by 10.

lifetime *= 1 + 0.1 * log10(Workers / 1e6)

nodes.description: Repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat.
nodes.technicalDescription: Every research also reduces the cost of the research by the listed value (so Science Boost 300% and Cash Boost 250% means Science Boost costs 4x less and Cash Boost costs 3.5x less).

nodes.description: Fly your Rocket from pad to pad and try not to crash!
nodes.technicalDescription: Panels per second is multiplied by Log20(Panels Per Second)

nodes.description: Folding particles back in on themselves allow you to form the universes first singularities. Perhaps this technology could benefit your Data Centers somehow?
nodes.technicalDescription:
Data Centers produce Servers based on Log2(Assembly Line Production) ^ Log10(Assembly Line Production).

Requires at least 1 production from AI Managers.

nodes.description: Utilize your overwhelming firepower (Daka daka) to enslave other spacefaring races. Humanity first!
nodes.technicalDescription: 40x Panel production.

nodes.description: Shift your goals into the research sector with singular focus.
nodes.technicalDescription: 20x Science, 0.25x Cash

nodes.description: Teach some of your Scientists to discover planets for you.
nodes.technicalDescription:
Produces Planets based on Log10(Science Bots)

Starting at 10 Science Bots, you gain 1 Planet per second, this increases by 1 each time you multiply your Scientists by 10.

nodes.description: Self improving bots create a surge in scientific progress.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies Science by 5 while you have at least 50% of bots assigned to Science.

nodes.description: Learn to build taller server racks and better cooling. Servers can run twice as many managers.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies Servers AI Manager production by 2.

nodes.description: Have you heard of matrioshka worlds? Basically worlds layered into worlds layered into worlds. This technique, other than extremely space efficient, allows planets to give birth to more planets based on how many planets exist.
nodes.technicalDescription: Gain Planets based on log2(Planets).

nodes.description: You are not alone, in the endless expanse of space. Others share the same goal as you, and together you will act as a protector and guidance to all not yet spacefaring forms of life.
nodes.technicalDescription: +600 seconds of Panel Lifetime.

nodes.description: Transplanting these weird looking shoulders should be fine, right?
nodes.technicalDescription: Shoulders of the Fallen now also affect Pocket Dimensions.

nodes.description: You find an extinct civilization and learn from their mistakes.
nodes.technicalDescription: Scientific Planets also produce Science Boosts.

nodes.description: The Shoulders of Precursors is a powerful artifact with the ability to multiply wealth and knowledge. It negates the effects of other wealth multipliers and also affects cash. This mysterious relic from a lost civilization is highly valuable and sought after. Its true potential remains unknown.
nodes.technicalDescription:
Disable Cash Multipliers, Science Multipliers additionally affect Cash.

Mutually exclusive with Shoulders of the Enlightened.

nodes.description: The "Shoulders of the Enlightened" are a pair of mysterious and powerful artifacts that grant immense knowledge and understanding to their bearer, along with the ability to generate great wealth.
nodes.technicalDescription: Scientific Planets also produces Cash Boosts. Mutually Exclusive with Shoulders of the Precursors.

nodes.description: The Shoulders of the Fallen are a revered artifact said to have belonged to great leaders of a lost civilization. They possess the power to enhance Planet production, the extent of which is determined by the number of science boosts acquired. This makes the Shoulders a valuable addition to any empire seeking to increase its production and growth. The true nature and history of this powerful relic remains a mystery, but those who possess it are rumored to have an edge in their quest for expansion and prosperity.
nodes.technicalDescription: Scientific Planets create additional Planets based on Log2(Science Boosts)

nodes.description: The "Shoulders of the Revolution" is a phrase that refers to a powerful financial system that harnesses the latest advancements in science to dramatically increase wealth. It is said to be built upon the innovations and insights of previous generations of thinkers, and it represents a new era of prosperity and progress for those who use it.
nodes.technicalDescription: Gain 1% additional Cash per Science Boost.

nodes.description: You noticed a significant efficiency potential. By introducing tiny condensed spheres (nicknamed bubbles) of solar energy, your panels in the pocket dimensions have something to do, resulting in a significant boost to production.
nodes.technicalDescription: Pocket Dimensions gain 1% production boost for every second of Panel Lifetime.

nodes.description: Through improvements to core algorithms you improve the efficiency of your bots.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase Cash and Science by 20%

nodes.description: Spending some extra time in a system lets you improve the efficiency of things.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase Assembly Line Bot production by 1% per second of Panel Lifetime

nodes.description: A price must be paid for greater profits.
nodes.technicalDescription: All Panel Lifetime x10. Cash / 100. Bots Sacrificed x100. May the stars have mercy.

nodes.description: You use AI to improve construction processes. New molecular structures allow you to use less materials in the process.
nodes.technicalDescription: Divide Bots required for Stellar Sacrifices by 1000.

nodes.description: Obliterating even more Bots greatly improve the rate at which you generate artificial Planets, however this is costly.
nodes.technicalDescription: Stellar Sacrifices Galaxies are 1000x better, however you divide your Cash, and Science by Stellar Galaxies.

nodes.description: You decide to start utilizing the materials in your own bots to create additional planet sized structures for your empire.
nodes.technicalDescription:
Every second destroy Bots equal to Stars Surrounded and gain Planets equal to Log10(Stellar Galaxies Engulfed) ^ 2.

A stellar galaxy is just a normal galaxy with stellar modifiers added.

nodes.description: Scattering... Something... Causes a perpetually increasing value to affect everything you touch.
nodes.technicalDescription: For each second this skill is assigned and the app is running, all production increases by 1% this scales additively, and resets on Infinity/Quantum Leap.

nodes.description: Why not double the amount of panels per swarm?
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase the 1% production gain after 100 purchases to 2%

nodes.description: Supercharge your power grid, drastically improving the performance of your empire!
nodes.technicalDescription: Boosts all Buildings, Cash, and Science by 50%

nodes.description: You discover a way to utilize supernovas to melt bots faster.
nodes.technicalDescription: Stellar Sacrifices Galaxies are 1000x better, however manually purchased buildings no longer boost production.

nodes.description: After getting your first taste of real power you crave more. Seek it out.
nodes.technicalDescription: 50% stronger Assembly Lines, AI Managers, Servers, Data Centers, and Planets. 25% less Cash and Science.

nodes.description: Your planets are the biggest wheel of progress. They spin around and make more servers, they sure look like a spring in Denver.
nodes.technicalDescription: Bought Planets also count towards bought Servers.

nodes.description: Focusing on more earthlike planets allows humanity to thrive, increasing the rate of progression.
nodes.technicalDescription: Bought Planets also count towards Bought Data Centers.

nodes.description: "Glory to your planets". The new galactic mega corporation motto, that surprisingly reduces the cost of getting more planets. Maybe you should come out with more of them.
nodes.technicalDescription: Total Planets reduce the cost of bought Planets.

nodes.description: Okay, the description is a bit misleading. Your planets aren't weak nor crippled, they are just sanctuaries for the smaller and weaker members of your empire (your AI Managers, in this case).
nodes.technicalDescription: Bought Planets also count towards bought AI Managers.

nodes.description: You aren't quite sure why, but every planet you manually spend resources to get shines bright like a diamond. It might have to do with bombing the planet afterwards with metric tons of diamonds.
nodes.technicalDescription: Bought Planets now count Twelve Times.

nodes.description: Earth is threatened with extinction in the year 2149. The Shannon family transport themselves back a million years, where colonies of humans have a second chance to build a civilisation.
nodes.technicalDescription: Planet Boost effect also reduces the Cost of new Planets.

nodes.description: There aren't any planets like yours. And that's because you are amazing! Also because each planet is filled to the brim with Assembly Lines, Managers, Servers and Data Centers.
nodes.technicalDescription: Bought Planets also count towards bought Assembly Lines.

nodes.description: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to discover new Planets, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?
nodes.technicalDescription: Assemble an additional Planet per second. Get an additional Planet for every other purchased Fragment Skill.

nodes.description: Pushing the limits is what you do best.
nodes.technicalDescription: Increase the production multiplier from 3% to 5%

nodes.description: Lowering Suspicion allows... wait, wrong game.
nodes.technicalDescription: Get 10x as many Servers from Rudimentary Singularity.

nodes.description: Stuff happens, and your production layout is prepared for everything and anything. This allows for a flexible production boost, boosting the highest and the lowest layer of the dyson swarm.
nodes.technicalDescription: You now produce 50% more AI Managers. Additionally, after 100 Planets, Planets production boosted by 50%

nodes.description: Sick of imagining what could have been you decide to put your imagination into action.
nodes.technicalDescription: Shoulders of Giants now additionally work off Pocket Dimensions.

nodes.description: Death, life, death, life. An eternal loop of what will come to pass. Being prepared not only helps your psychology, but also your pocket dimensions.
nodes.technicalDescription: Every bought Data Center gives a 1% boost to production of Data Centers.

nodes.description: Additional worker bots can now be used as home assistants... At a cost of course!
nodes.technicalDescription: For every 1% invested in Workers, +100% Cash production.

nodes.description: CPU upgrades allow your workers to operate additional arms, making them twice as effective.
nodes.technicalDescription: Multiplies Panel production by 2.

nodes.description: Worthy Sacrifice is a legendary trade-off, balancing panel longevity for efficient assembly. It requires bold leadership and a deep understanding of organizational values. A symbol of determination and strategic thinking, it is remembered as a tale of calculated risk-taking.
nodes.technicalDescription: Panel Lifetime will be reduced by 50%, but Assembly Lines will be 5x as effective.
